headline: Jumbo: Net Profit of €120.6 Million in H1 - Extraordinary Distribution of €1.00 per Share
summary: Jumbo Group reported first-half 2026 sales of €519.26 million, up 4.42%, and net profit of €120.60 million, up 2.92%. It also announced an extraordinary distribution of €1.00 per share.
why: Jumbo is a Greek retail group operating toy and children's product stores and is listed on the Athens Stock Exchange. Its results and shareholder distributions are watched by investors in Greek equities.
